Hi all,

Thanks Elena — below are concrete answers you can use for procurement and the DPA draft. I’m attaching the completed SIG and a redacted SOC 2 Type II.

Summary of guarantees and options:

1) EU-only processing
- Redwood Private: we can deploy a private control plane and inference nodes fully within an EU region (we typically use eu-west-1). All control plane components, logs, and artifact storage can be configured to remain in-region.
- Dedicated capacity: we can reserve GPU pools in EU-only regions and enforce routing policies to keep inference traffic in-region.
- Contractual: we are prepared to commit to an EU-only processing clause in the DPA with SCCs incorporated.

2) VPC and key management
- VPC model: customer VPC peering with dedicated private endpoints and option for a customer-side NAT. Private supports customer-managed network controls and isolated subnets.
- KMS/HSM: we support customer-managed keys via KMS integrations. For air-gapped/HSM requirements we offer an on-prem bundle (multi-week onboarding) or bring-your-own-HSM integrations for private deployments.

3) Data handling and retention
- Backups and snapshots can be restricted to EU regions; retention windows are configurable per-customer.
- We support token-level redaction and can configure ingest-time filters if Novamed requires minimal retention.

4) Evidence and documentation
- Attached: Novamed_SIG_Responses.xlsx (answers to SIG/CAIQ), DPA_draft_v3.docx (our baseline DPA with SCCs), SOC2_TypeII_redacted.pdf (redacted report).
- Pen test summary: we can share an executive summary under an NDA if needed.

5) DPIA language & mitigation text (suggested paragraph for procurement)
"Redwood Inference will process Novamed data exclusively within the European Economic Area. Customer data, backups, and system artifacts will be stored in EU-hosted infrastructure. Access to production data is restricted to authorized personnel and limited by role-based access controls; encryption at rest and in transit is enforced; customer-managed key options are available. Redwood will cooperate with Novamed in DPIA assessments and provide technical details and evidence required for regulatory filings."

Next steps we propose:
- Novamed review DPA_draft_v3 and provide redlines by 2025-11-12
- Redwood security to push final SIG/CAIQ and redacted SOC2 to procurement by 2025-11-10
- Legal/proc call week of 2025-11-17 to finalize signature and deployment timeline (aim to have DPA signed by 2025-11-20)

Ask for Legal (Laura): we will need an enterprise addendum to commit to a data residency SLA for this account. Can you confirm approval to offer a bounded contractual residency commitment (standard one-year term with geography binding) so we can present to Novamed?

Attachments: DPA_draft_v3.docx; Novamed_SIG_Responses.xlsx; SOC2_TypeII_redacted.pdf

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Product Privacy & Compliance — Redwood Inference
